models.specSource: UTAX English operation guide P-4030D/DN family p.A-14/A-16 (TA German OG identical); KXv4 GPD/property bag utlp6220.bag
models.notes: Hardware IDs and driver names verified in both official INFs (KXv4 6.1.1603 prnkycl1.inf [UTAX/TA.NTamd64]; KX 8.7.0917 64bit\OEMSETUP.INF [TA/UTAX.NTamd64.6.0]). IEEE 1284 MFG/MDL split inferred from the hardware ID (UTAX_TA + P-4030DN). networkModelNames is the vendor installer's SNMP model id (KmInstall4.ini, Kyocera OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.1347.43.5.1.1.1.1), not yet confirmed on hardware. Kyocera equivalent: FS-2100DN. The ticket is narrower than the cassette minimum (140 mm), so only the MP tray can feed it.

models.specSource: TA English operation guide P-4531DN family p.A-14; KXv4 property bag utlp11720.bag; KX 8.7 UTLP11720.XML
models.notes: LPTENUM ID appears in the KXv4 INF only; USBPRINT/WSDPRINT IDs appear in both official INFs. The UTAX datasheet limits the P-4531DN cassette to A5R and larger and the driver data gives a 140 x 210 mm cassette minimum; either way only the MP tray can feed the ticket. Kyocera equivalent: ECOSYS P3045dn (explicit in the TA EU declaration of conformity).

models.specSource: TA English operation guide P-4532DN/P-5032DN/P-5532DN Rev 1 p.11-21; KXv4 property bag utlp13920.bag; KX 8.7 UTLP13920.XML
models.notes: Only USBPRINT/WSDPRINT IDs exist in the official INFs (TA_UTAXP-5032DNEED0). The vendor installer database (KmInstall4.ini) also lists UTAX_TAP-5032DNC673 for some units, hence the second IEEE 1284 pair (from vendor data, not the INF). The driver defaults to two-sided printing; the tool forces single-sided. The XPS package has a PrinterDriverID defect for this model; the PCL6 package is used. Kyocera equivalent: ECOSYS P3150dn.

models.specSource: Kyocera operation guide FS-2100D/2100DN/4100DN/4200DN/4300DN Rev.2 p.A-14/A-16; KXv4 6.2.2215 GPD kmfs2100npcl6.gpd
models.notes: Hardware IDs and v4 driver names verified in the official Kyocera KXv4 6.2.2215 INF (PCL Driver/64bit prnkycl1.inf [Kyocera.NTamd64]); the v3 name 'Kyocera FS-2100DN KX' in the Kyocera KX 6.2.1113 INF. IEEE 1284 MFG/MDL split inferred from the hardware ID (Kyocera + FS-2100DN). networkModelNames is the vendor installer's SNMP model id (KmInstall4.ini, USB VID_0482&PID_049d), not yet confirmed on hardware. TA/UTAX twin of the P-4030DN: its GPD is identical to utlp2100npcl6.gpd except names and version (MP tray = option Manual, OptionID 4; custom size 70 x 148 to 216 x 356 mm). The ticket is narrower than the cassette minimum (140 mm), so only the MP tray can feed it.

models.specSource: Kyocera operation guide FS-2100D/2100DN/4100DN/4200DN/4300DN Rev.2 p.A-14/A-16; KXv4 6.2.2215 GPD kmfs2100pcl6.gpd
models.notes: The non-network FS-2100 (USB; network only with an optional interface card). Hardware IDs and v4 driver names verified in the official Kyocera KXv4 6.2.2215 INF (PCL Driver/64bit prnkycl1.inf [Kyocera.NTamd64]); the v3 name 'Kyocera FS-2100D KX' in the Kyocera KX 6.2.1113 INF. networkModelNames is the vendor installer's SNMP model id (KmInstall4.ini, USB VID_0482&PID_049c), not yet confirmed on hardware. TA/UTAX twin of the P-4030D; same paper path as the FS-2100DN (GPD identical to utlp2100pcl6.gpd except names, version and one optional-cassette constraint). Only the MP tray can feed the ticket.

driverPackages.displayName: TA Triumph-Adler KX XPS Universal Print Driver (KXv4) 6.1.1603 - PCL6 driver
driverPackages.driverType: Windows v4 printer driver (GPD-based, XPS to PCL XL filter), WHQL-signed
driverPackages.notes: Listed with the same URL on the TA P-4030DN, P-4531DN and P-5032DN pages and the UTAX pages. Size and SHA-256 independently re-verified from two downloads. Catalog prnkycl1.cat is WHQL (Microsoft Windows Hardware Compatibility Publisher), timestamped, valid for Windows 10.0. Covers all three models for x64 under [UTAX/TA.NTamd64].

driverPackages.displayName: Kyocera KX v4 Printer Driver 6.2.2215 - PCL6 driver
driverPackages.driverType: Windows v4 printer driver (GPD-based, XPS to PCL XL filter), WHQL-signed
driverPackages.approvedBy: Added 2026-11-10 for the Kyocera FS-2100D/DN (IT to countersign)
driverPackages.notes: Kyocera Europe download centre, 'KX v4 Printer Driver (v.6.2.2215)', served as Kxv4Driver_signed.zip (no redirect). The URL carries no version: when Kyocera publishes a newer build there, its SHA-256 no longer matches and the online download is refused, so ship this archive in the distribution's drivers folder. Catalog prnkycl1.cat is WHQL (Microsoft Windows Hardware Compatibility Publisher), timestamped, valid for Windows 10.0 x64. Covers FS-2100D and FS-2100DN for x64 under [Kyocera.NTamd64]; each manifest's PrinterDriverID matches its INF line.

driverPackages.displayName: TA Triumph-Adler KX Universal Print PCL/PostScript Driver 8.7.0917
driverPackages.driverType: Kyocera KX v3 printer driver (vendor GDI driver), Authenticode-signed by KYOCERA Document Solutions Inc. (not WHQL)
driverPackages.notes: Alternative, not preferred by any model. Its x64 catalog is vendor-signed (thumbprint AA2098F3E70AC791261FF95930AE4C981B28C0D3), so Windows installs it silently only when that certificate is in the LocalMachine Trusted Publishers store (deploy by GPO); otherwise silent installation is refused (expected HRESULT 0x800F0242). To use it, deploy the certificate and set a model's preferredDriverName to 'P-xxxx KX' and driverPackageId to this id. Never use the package's arm64 INF on x64.
